description: This file defines a generic interface for a catalog lookup data service in a Blazor application, including an asynchronous method to list lookup data items.

classes.name: ICatalogLookupDataService<TLookupData>
classes.description: A generic interface for catalog lookup data services, constrained to LookupData types, providing a task-based method to retrieve a list of lookup data.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of lookup data items.
